List WHO BMI-for-age rows, birth to 5 years (kg/m2, with L/M/S)

GET /bmi-for-age-under-5 · API key required

Parameters

  • sex (query)
  • age_months (query)
  • limit (query)
  • offset (query)
  • cursor (query) - Switches to keyset pagination when present (even empty). See README § Pagination. Response then has has_more/next_cursor instead of count/offset, and is always ordered by id.asc.

Responses

  • 200
